test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the term that can replace the question mark (?) in the following analogy.

STYLE : 81 : ARRIVAL :: CRACK : 36 : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8a5382e2e7885f58257880cdd16e55f5e77f4c4416619646dadc4e261187159.png] 

The logic followed here is :

 
• Consider **STYLE : 81 : ARRIVAL**

STYLE:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c58e5252cf9f5746b09e728f5e45a49430f0083601f0a3f8818c54ad9326e5e2.png] 

⇒ 19 + 20 + 25 + 12 + 5 = 81

Similarly, ARRIVAL:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8196c8255e8c0713464274336bc4160ab76c9387a048666fbc90e4bd3c4873d.png] 

⇒ 1 + 18 + 18 + 9 + 22 + 1 + 12 = 81

Now, 

 
• CRACK : 36 : ?

CRACK:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb1fc82ceb855e6044658104c985feb9213a0fe5bed8cbaffefa2002208d0c93.png] 

⇒ 3 + 18 + 1 + 3 + 11 = 36

Option 1) SMELL :

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57001fbe4cabf06406bc753b65543a44ec9ab561ba0ea646efb1f9ccfc07567b.png] 

⇒ 19 + 13 + 5 + 12 + 12 = 61

Option 2) STREAM:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05460366e99daa93b974ebfec20e85eb626b497c0f348ce26227436d4f9b42c1.png] 

⇒ 19 + 20 + 18 + 5 + 1 + 13 = 76

Option 3) **RIDE:**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7763853390134b728d60a92c919964b1f891f8b12f88ba0f5e99e1e81494336.png] 

**⇒ 18 + 9 + 4 + 5 = 36**

Option 4) ROSE:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32c612580a8706d70b0ce7488c0224e12f5315ee85e104f1ea379fe35e3a99c8.png] 

⇒ 18 + 15 + 19 + 5 = 57

∴ Here, sum of positional values of the word RIDE is 36.

Hence, the correct answer is **"36".**
